svg.text: Fix 1: count only the informative k-mers, where they help
folder new_model/fix1 · same pools, same HMM · only the k-mers counted in some windows change
The problem: windows where the teosinte keeps most B73 k-mers
e.g. parviglumis chr7 54-65 Mb: the teosinte has 90% of the B73 single-copy k-mers. Those shared k-mers are found in every pool,
whatever its state, so they add counting noise and no signal. DONOR and SEG end up less than one noise unit apart.
shared with the teosinte: found in B73, SEG and DONOR pools
informative: missing in the teosinte, found only from B73 DNA
Keep only the informative k-mers (fx1_1, fx1_2)
Informative k-mers of a taxon = B73 single-copy k-mers found in NONE of that taxon's assemblies (KMC: B73 list minus each assembly).
Every pool is recounted against its taxon's list (as step 17); the 10 B73 controls are counted against all five lists.
Fewer k-mers per window (more counting noise), but every one of them carries signal: DONOR pools lose most of them, SEG pools about half.
Score the window again with the informative k-mers
Same normalisation as step 20 (pool ÷ B73 controls). Our donors still carry some of these k-mers, so their DONOR level is learned (panel 4).
contrast = gap between SEG and DONOR ÷ noise of the window (whiskers = ±1 noise unit). Contrasts: parviglumis chr7 54-65 Mb, pilot; bar heights illustrative
Choose window by window, then run the same HMM (fx1_3 to fx1_6)
A window switches if B73 has ≥ 200 informative k-mers there AND the new contrast is ≥ 1.2 × the old one (measured from all pools of the taxon).
Switched windows take their DONOR level and its spread from our pools called DONOR there (the assemblies have none of these k-mers).
informative k-mers (33-53% of the measured windows, by taxon)
all B73 k-mers, assembly level (as before)
the SEG island inside DONOR disappears (chr7 54-65 Mb: 28 → 7 pools)
Targeted sequencing (85 plots): SEG tracts that are AB 74% → 86% (AA, i.e. no teosinte, 18% → 6%); DONOR tracts that are BB 91% → 96%;
B73 tracts that are AA 97% → 97%. Not fixed: chr6 21-23 and chr1 297 Mb (a wrong DONOR level, not low contrast) and parviglumis chr3 75-78 Mb.
